status.summary: Lost his first pro fight in his first UFC title shot: Alexander Volkanovski stopped him with punches from half guard at 4:54 of round 2 at UFC 333 (Abu Dhabi, Oct 24, 2026). He entered 20-0. He landed 3 of 4 takedowns in round 1 but turned them into only 31 seconds of control, then was stuffed on all three shots in round 2 and out-landed 32-20 before the finish. Afterwards he offered no excuses and praised Volkanovski (MMA Junkie and SI, Oct 24-25). Paddy Pimblett and TJ Dillashaw said he gave up late in the fight (Sherdog, Oct 26; BJPenn, Nov 4), while Volkanovski said Evloev would 'walk through' the rest of the division (Sherdog, Oct 27). Before that he beat Lerone Murphy by majority decision (48-46, 48-46, 47-47) in a five-round London main event (Mar 21, 2026), after a point deduction for groin strikes, and beat Aljamain Sterling by UD (UFC 310, Dec 7, 2024). Pro record 20-1-0 (ESPN, UFCalendar, ufcrankings.org); UFC 10-1. Still No. 1 at featherweight after UFC 333. No bout booked (ESPN, UFCalendar on Nov 6), and no injury or medical suspension was reported from UFC 333. Age 32. He trains at American Top Team (ESPN).

style.summary: A wrestle-boxer who wins on takedown volume and control rather than damage: ten UFC wins, all on the scorecards, and no knockdowns scored. He boxes at range (88% of his landed significant strikes over three years came at distance) with a head-first mix that has added body punching, and his output and wrestling rise as the fight goes on. Volkanovski showed the counter: get up from the early takedowns, stuff the later ones and hit him as he resets.

moves.notes: Target split from fighters.json: decayed significant attempts are 80% head, 14% body, 6% legs (landed 69/22/8); career 86/9/5, last 3 years 77/17/6. Body weights are set above his career mix because the recent fights carry more body work (33 of 86 landed vs Murphy were body strikes), and they lean to punches (body hooks and straights) over kicks as a judgment: ufcstats does not split punches from kicks, and his low leg-strike share suggests he kicks little (80% of decayed landed strikes come at distance, which covers both). Leg kicks are low (6% of attempts, league 9.5%). Knees are small (8% of decayed landed strikes in the clinch). Spinning is zero. ufcstats does not record technique, so the split inside each target is a judgment; no scouting breakdown of his striking could be opened this pass.

engine_notes.note: Chin: 0 knockdowns absorbed in 11 UFC fights (323 significant head strikes absorbed). His one loss, to Volkanovski, was a TKO by punches from half guard with no knockdown recorded.
Takedowns against elite get-ups do not become rides: 3 of 4 in R1 vs Volkanovski produced 31 s of control, and 5 of 17 vs Allen produced 3:31.

Pace: in nine three-round fights his landed rate is 1.00, 1.64, 1.67 of R1. Only two five-round fights (Murphy, Volkanovski), so the 5-round curve in fighters.json (1, 1.21, 1.61, 1.35, 0.77) rests on one bout after R2.
Defense at range is good: opponents land 32% of head strikes on him career (league 39%); opponent-adjusted, he absorbs 0.73x what opponents usually land.
